legal_reviewer_reference.rule: Must identify a real independent legal review authority/reference. This preparation cannot create or substitute that review.

approved_terms_document.rule: A real approved Terms of Use artifact must exist. Only its SHA-256 is copied to the candidate receipt.

approved_terms_version.rule: Version must be explicit and stable enough to bind later acceptance evidence to the reviewed document.

stable_published_terms_url.rule: Must be the stable public production route for the reviewed terms; localhost, example/test placeholders and ephemeral preview URLs are rejected.

effective_date.rule: Must be explicitly supplied from the reviewed terms authority; collector does not infer it.

billing_cancellation_refund_policy_artif.rule: A reviewed artifact/reference covering billing, cancellation and refund policy must exist; receipt stores only SHA-256.

contract_acceptance_versioning_artifact.rule: Evidence must describe how acceptance is bound to terms version; receipt stores only SHA-256.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: COLLECT_DIGEST_ONLY_RECEIPT
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Collect hashes and non-sensitive metadata from the real reviewed artifacts; no network or database mutation.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEW_RECEIPT_AND_SOURCE_ARTIFACTS
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Verify that the legal review is real, published URL/version match, and billing/cancellation/refund plus acceptance/versioning evidence are actually covered.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: PROMOTE_DEDICATED_EVIDENCE_MIGRATION
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Only after real review, create a separate versioned migration that updates exactly legal_terms_of_use with evidence_ref and evidence_digest.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: MERGE_GREEN_THEN_APPLY_ONCE
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Apply exact merged evidence migration through Supabase.apply_migration only. execute_sql remains SELECT-only.
